[P0] Preserve the fallback for throwing deadline readers

When a test or non-Lambda context's `getRemainingTimeInMillis()` throws, this now propagates through `assertTimeToDeliver` into the request step. A plain `Error` is not retried by default, so the job fails with `MicrovmDeliveryError` and its MicroVM is terminated instead of proceeding without a deadline. Rule 4 in the base SDK's `AGENTS.md` explicitly requires throwing deadline readings to mean no deadline; this PR adds no superseding ADR. Restore the catch returning `undefined`, and update the new regression test to verify successful delivery using that fallback.
